name: Vtreshi
desc:
Vtreshi is an Etrean NPC. She is an apprentice Diver who was a member of an expedition to the [Second Layer](location:second_layer).

Following her desertion from Chaser's expedition team to [the Ignition Union](faction:the_ignition_union) in hopes of escaping the Second Layer, she was ultimately turned away and left to rot in the [Ethironal Shrine Sanctuary](location:ethironal_shrine_sanctuary), unable to receive a union hook for herself.
additional_info: -   Racial variant of Vtreshi is File.
